title: Repair GitHub Sync existing-identity sign-in routing
summary: Load current authenticated linked identities instead of treating an identity-free JWT snapshot as unlinked, recheck link versus renew before OAuth, and preserve provider failure codes from both callback queries and fragments.
dataSourcesChanged: Read current auth.identities scoped to the authenticated user for Sync, repository browsing and import access. No identity or schema mutations.
concurrencyRisk: Identity lookup failure never starts linking. Recheck current browser identities before OAuth; cancelled/superseded attempts do not navigate. Existing callback account/session mismatch checks remain authoritative.

metrics: Existing auth callback timing and durable sync run stages/results

rollback.strategy: Revert the linked-user helper, consumers and OAuth error routing together. No schema migration or data rollback; do not detach or transfer identities.
validation: Missing snapshot identities do not imply an absent GitHub link
Authoritative empty identities and lookup failures remain distinct
Identity conflicts are never labelled cancellation

commands: node --import tsx --test tests/unit/*github*.test.ts tests/unit/files-tab/*github*.test.ts tests/unit/repo-validation.test.ts tests/unit/auth-oauth.test.ts
npx eslint <changed sign-in modules and tests>
